messages.author: 0f89b14b3fb60e4b
messages.subject: Re: Newbie looking for a tutorial
parts:
Hi Rae,

After you install shiny in R ( install.packages("shiny", dependencies=TRUE) ), take a look at http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/ where you will see a link to the tutorials (http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/) written by the Shiny team.

I think you should go through the Shiny tutorials first, and then look for more resources when you're having trouble or when you want to explore more advanced applications.

Best,
Jonathan
